description.value:
Slot none; Price 10,000 gp (lesser), 20,000 gp (normal), 40,000 gp (greater)
Weight 5 lbs.; Feat Cost 2 sp

A traumatic talent causes lingering memories of pain and suffering in creatures harmed by it. When a creature fails a saving throw against a traumatic talent, the next time it sleeps it must succeed at a Will save with a DC equal to the original talent’s DC or be affected as if by nightmare (as the spell). Each time the target fails its save, it must save again the following night or be affected by another nightmare, though the save DC decreases by 2 each night after the first. This metamagic effect can be applied only to talents with the emotion or fear descriptor.

Construction Requirements
Craft Apparatus, Traumatic Spell; Cost 5,000 gp (lesser), 10,000 gp (normal), 20,000 gp (greater)

Source: Spheres of Power Wiki
description.instructions:
Selected profile: lesser tier; held slender rod. Apply as part of casting a qualifying sphere effect of caster level seven or lower. Hold this apparatus in at least one hand while applying it. Spend one of three daily uses; only one metamagic apparatus may apply per casting. Its feat's extra spell-point and casting-time costs are waived, but normal effect and other-metamagic costs still apply.

Only emotion- or fear-descriptor talents qualify, and the target must fail its original saving throw. At its next sleep it makes a Will save at the original DC against nightmare; each failure requires another save on the following night, reducing DC by two each night after the first. No immediate nightmare or global sleep effect is applied.

Shared metamagic apparatus rules. Feat Cost applies to taking the feat, not using the physical apparatus.
